column6: Worked: N/S stereographic charts give v = 1/conj(u); conjugating the second chart gives z -> 1/z, Jacobian = mult. by -1/z^2 in GL(2,R); cotangent = inverse transpose checks. Older text (not in scope): Q1 explanation says End(E) has fibers GL(Ep), should be End(Ep); Q1 "iff Euler class vanishes" holds for rank = dim M, not in general; Explainer calls connections sections of vector bundles (they form an affine space).
Checked Mobius + trivial line over S1: nowhere-zero section, w1 != 0 so not trivial. Agrees with Q1 explanation.
Worked: flow is rotation by t; X(x^2+y^2) = -2xy + 2xy = 0; d/dtheta = -r sin(theta) d/dx + r cos(theta) d/dy = -y d/dx + x d/dy.

Bullet 1 correction "holds only inside one chart" overstated: an embedded M in R^N or a parallelizable M with a global frame also gives a function picture. Changed to "works inside one chart, but it depends on the chart". Other bullets checked: hairy ball + Hopf (closed connected, chi = 0); x^2 d/dx blows up at t = 1/x0; XY second order, XY - YX = [X,Y].
